verses.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਉਪੰਨੇ ਸਾਇਰਹੁ ਭੀ ਪਾਣੀ ਖਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: ratan upa(n)ne sairahu bhee paanee khaaraa|

en.bdb: Jewels have come out of sea but still its water is brackish.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਝਹੁ ਸੁਝਨਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਲੋਅ ਅਉਲੰਗੁ ਵਿਚਿਕਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: sujhahu sujhan tin loa aaula(n)g vichikaaraa|

en.bdb: In the light of moon, the three worlds are seen, yet the stigma on moon persists.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਅੰਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਲਰੁ ਭਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: dharatee upajai a(n)n dhan vich kalar bhaaraa|

en.bdb: The earth produces the corn but still alkaline earth is also there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਈਸਰੁ ਤੁਸੈ ਹੋਰਨਾ ਘਰਿ ਖਪਰੁ ਛਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: e'eesar tusai horanaa ghar khapar chhaaraa|

en.bdb: Siva, getting happy, grants boons to others but in his own home only ashes and begging bowl are found.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉਂ ਹਣਵੰਤਿ ਕਛੋਟੜਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੈ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: jiau(n) hanava(n)t kachhoTaRaa kiaa karai vichaaraa|

en.bdb: The powerful Hanuman can do a lot for others but has only a loincloth to wear.
Who can efface the words of destiny of the apostate.
